response.summary: Operating margin is 13.59%. Monthly revenue is €412,000 against operating costs of €356,000, leaving a monthly operating profit of €56,000.
concerns: Cash runway is 8 months under the zero-revenue stress case, so margin has limited room to absorb new fixed costs.
Outstanding receivables of €74,000 are not yet collected cash.
response.recommendation: Hold operating costs flat while revenue grows. A monthly operating profit of €56,000 is workable, but it is thin enough that any new recurring cost should be evaluated against the €52,000 available hiring budget rather than against revenue.
missingInformation: No per-department cost allocation is available, so margin cannot be attributed to a specific team.
No committed new-revenue pipeline is modelled, so growth remains a projection.
